description: Test suite for custom profile attributes API in Mattermost, including creation, listing, patching, deletion of CPA fields and values, with license and permission checks, websocket event verification, and validation of LDAP/SAML constraints.

methods.name: TestCreateCPAField
methods.description: Tests creation of CPA fields, including license validation, permission checks, sanitization, websocket event firing, and admin management.

methods.name: TestListCPAFields
methods.description: Tests listing of CPA fields, license validation, and filtering of deleted fields.

methods.name: TestPatchCPAField
methods.description: Tests patching (updating) CPA fields, including sanitization, event firing, validation, and permission checks.

methods.name: TestDeleteCPAField
methods.description: Tests deletion of CPA fields, license validation, permission checks, and websocket event firing.

methods.name: TestListCPAValues
methods.description: Tests listing of CPA values, including license validation, permission restrictions, and handling of array and LDAP/SAML constraints.

methods.name: TestPatchCPAValues
methods.description: Tests patching (creating/updating) CPA values, including validation, permission checks, websocket events, and LDAP/SAML constraints.

methods.name: TestPatchCPAValuesForUser
methods.description: Tests user-specific CPA value updates, validation, permission restrictions, and LDAP/SAML constraints.
